name: Brandye
summary: Shopify app that adds an AI product-finder quiz, AI-generated questions and answers on product pages and an AI shopping assistant trained on your catalogue, with email capture and sync to Klaviyo and other marketing tools.
best_for: Shopify stores with a catalogue where shoppers need help choosing, such as skincare, supplements or gifts, that want a product-finder quiz, answers on product pages and a chat assistant in one app, and value a small team that helps set it up
skip_if: you want a free plan to run on for months, because the free allowance is 100 submissions and 100 chats in total; or you sell mainly to shoppers in languages other than English and need that confirmed on the listing; or you only need a quiz, because a dedicated quiz app gives more submissions per dollar
honest_knock:
Read the free plan as a trial, not a tier. Its 100 quiz submissions and 100 chats are lifetime totals, not monthly, so a store with real traffic uses them up in days or weeks and then has to pay. Data retention is the other quiet limit: the free plan keeps 15 days of data and Starter 30, so the quiz answers and chat history you would use to spot patterns over a season are only kept for 90 days on Growth at $129 a month or above.

The Shopify listing shows four plans and stops at $129. The vendor's own pricing page goes on to Scale at $249 and Brand at $599 a month, so a growing store that reads only the listing will not see where the ladder ends. The listing also gives English as the only language, while 11 of its 12 reviews come from French stores and are written in French, so check how the quiz and assistant handle your shoppers' language before you rely on them.

The reviews are uniformly positive but say little that can be checked. Most praise the team as much as the app, naming the founder and describing hands-on help with installing and customising the quiz, and several were written after days or weeks of use. One says conversion went up and returns went down, without figures. The homepage figures of a 16% higher average order value and five times the conversion rate are, by Brandye's own footnote, indicative midpoints of its reported ranges, not measurements we can verify. Brandye's legal page lists quiz responses among the data it collects and says collected data is used, among other things, for marketing and retargeting campaigns; it does not say whether that covers your shoppers' answers or only visitors to brandye.com, so ask before you install if that matters to you. We have not installed the app.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 200 quiz submissions and 500 chats a month, 30 days of data, 14-day free trial
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-02 and re-verified unchanged 2026-11-12 on brandye.com/pricing and on apps.shopify.com/brandye-quiz-ai-recommendation) Every plan includes the product quiz, the AI shopping assistant and AI product questions; the tiers differ in how many quiz submissions and chats you get and how long your data is kept. Free covers up to 100 quiz submissions and 100 chats in total, lifetime rather than per month, with 15 days of data. Starter is $19 a month for 200 submissions and 500 chats a month with 30 days of data. Booster is $49 a month for 500 submissions and 1,500 chats with 60 days. Growth is $129 a month for 1,000 submissions and 3,000 chats with 90 days. Those four are the only plans on the Shopify listing, which shows yearly prices of $190 for Starter, $470.40 for Booster and $1,238.40 for Growth, and a 14-day free trial on each paid plan. The vendor's own pricing page adds two higher tiers the listing does not show: Scale at $249 a month for 2,500 submissions and 6,000 chats, and Brand at $599 a month for 6,000 submissions and 15,000 chats, both with 90 days of data, plus Enterprise on request; it advertises 20% off for yearly billing. We could not tell from either page whether Scale and Brand are billed through Shopify like the listed plans; Brandye's help centre (article published 12 August 2026, read 12 November 2026) says only that Brandye is billed through Shopify, without singling out those two. Listed charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer Brandye SAS of Bussy-Saint-Georges, France; the listing gives a launch date of 10 September 2025 and shows 12 reviews, none of them critical (13, all five stars, on 12 November 2026).

Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-12.

free_plan_evidence: Free covers up to 100 quiz submissions and 100 chats in total, lifetime rather than per month, with 15 days of data.

compare_with.name: RevenueHunt
compare_with.why: RevenueHunt is the established product-quiz app on Shopify and the first alternative the listing suggests. Read on its Shopify listing on 2 October 2026, it gives 100 quiz responses a month free, then $39 a month for 500, $99 for 1,000 and $199 for 2,500, with a 15-day free trial and 12 listed languages. Brandye's free plan is 100 submissions in total rather than per month, and its 500-submission tier costs $49 rather than $39. What the extra money buys is the AI side: an AI shopping assistant and AI questions on product pages, with 1,500 chats a month on that tier, which RevenueHunt's listing does not offer. A store that wants a quiz alone fits RevenueHunt; a store that wants the quiz plus an assistant answering product questions fits Brandye, at a price.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Brandye on a Shopify development store: the install, the onboarding, one AI generated product quiz saved and set live, the Recommendation tab, the Shopify plan page that offered no plans and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid and no approval screen was reached; the app embed was saved in the theme. Install: the install form was sent at 12:52:43; the Install app dialog asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data and was approved. The app opened on Welcome to Brandye with the question What do you want to set up first? (AI Shopping Assistant, AI Product Questions, Product Finder Quiz), followed by an optional question How did you hear about Brandye? that we skipped. The dashboard said On your store 0 of 3 live. No separate account, card or phone number was asked. The buttons on the onboarding screen only reacted after a few seconds, and a first click on Create a quiz seemed to do nothing. Core action: from the dashboard, Quiz Set up, Create your quiz, Create quiz (Quiz 1) and Generate Quiz with AI. The dialog Generate quiz with AI had a prefilled Quiz goal and Target customers. The first Generate gave Couldn't generate your quiz and Try again. If it keeps failing, add more detail to the goal. The second try with our own goal (help shoppers pick the right snowboard for their riding level, terrain and budget) worked in about 10 seconds. Result: a flow diagram with 7 questions and branches (among them What's your current snowboarding experience level? and What is your target budget for the board?, and as last question an email request for a stance setup guide) that ends in a results node. We saved it with Save (Questions got a green tick), chose Placement Full-page quiz and saved it; the placement editor shows a style and a Gallery preview but no real shopper view. The dashboard then said Quiz Live with Quiz submissions 0 and Revenue influenced US$ 0, and the Recommendation tab said All products are currently eligible for recommendations. Timing, approximate tester observations: install at 12:52:43, quiz generated and saved at about 12:57 (about 4 minutes and 12 steps including the onboarding), Live on the dashboard at about 12:59. The shopper view was NOT seen: the theme editor showed the added Quiz app block (handle quiz-1, Embedded) empty in the preview, although the Brandye app embed was on. Plans: the app has no plan screen (its menu has AI Product Questions, Quizzes, AI Knowledge, MCP and Settings, and Settings holds only email summaries). The Shopify plan page for the app said Select a plan, No plans are available for your store and Contact the app developer for help choosing a plan. The App Store listing says Free plan available. Free trial available. and the dossier names Starter at $19, but nothing could be chosen or paid in our store. There was no Approve subscription screen, so nothing was approved and no card was asked. Cancelling: no plan or trial existed, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the app menu and Uninstall; the dialog Uninstall Brandye? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (Testing multiple apps). The uninstall was confirmed at about 13:01 and the app is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: the AI Shopping Assistant, AI Product Questions, French or other languages, the quiz in the store preview, a recommendation result, integrations such as Klaviyo, any plan or paid feature and a data export. Clean up: the app was uninstalled after the test. In the theme the Brandye app embed was switched on and saved, and the Home page got an empty Apps section because the Quiz app block was not kept after a reload; this stays in the theme and was not changed further. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The first AI generation failed, the onboarding buttons reacted slowly, the quiz block showed empty in the theme preview and was not kept after a reload, and the plan page of Shopify said that no plans were available for the store.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Brandye on a Shopify development store: the install, the onboarding, one AI generated product quiz saved and set live, the Recommendation tab, the Shopify plan page that offered no plans and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid and no approval screen was reached; the app embed was saved in the theme. Install: the install form was sent at 12:52:43; the Install app dialog asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data and was approved. The app opened on Welcome to Brandye with the question What do you want to set up first? (AI Shopping Assistant, AI Product Questions, Product Finder Quiz), followed by an optional question How did you hear about Brandye? that we skipped. The dashboard said On your store 0 of 3 live. No separate account, card or phone number was asked. The buttons on the onboarding screen only reacted after a few seconds, and a first click on Create a quiz seemed to do nothing. Core action: from the dashboard, Quiz Set up, Create your quiz, Create quiz (Quiz 1) and Generate Quiz with AI. The dialog Generate quiz with AI had a prefilled Quiz goal and Target customers. The first Generate gave Couldn't generate your quiz and Try again. If it keeps failing, add more detail to the goal. The second try with our own goal (help shoppers pick the right snowboard for their riding level, terrain and budget) worked in about 10 seconds. Result: a flow diagram with 7 questions and branches (among them What's your current snowboarding experience level? and What is your target budget for the board?, and as last question an email request for a stance setup guide) that ends in a results node. We saved it with Save (Questions got a green tick), chose Placement Full-page quiz and saved it; the placement editor shows a style and a Gallery preview but no real shopper view. The dashboard then said Quiz Live with Quiz submissions 0 and Revenue influenced US$ 0, and the Recommendation tab said All products are currently eligible for recommendations. Timing, approximate tester observations: install at 12:52:43, quiz generated and saved at about 12:57 (about 4 minutes and 12 steps including the onboarding), Live on the dashboard at about 12:59. The shopper view was NOT seen: the theme editor showed the added Quiz app block (handle quiz-1, Embedded) empty in the preview, although the Brandye app embed was on. Plans: the app has no plan screen (its menu has AI Product Questions, Quizzes, AI Knowledge, MCP and Settings, and Settings holds only email summaries). The Shopify plan page for the app said Select a plan, No plans are available for your store and Contact the app developer for help choosing a plan. The App Store listing says Free plan available. Free trial available. and the dossier names Starter at $19, but nothing could be chosen or paid in our store. There was no Approve subscription screen, so nothing was approved and no card was asked. Cancelling: no plan or trial existed, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the app menu and Uninstall; the dialog Uninstall Brandye? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (Testing multiple apps). The uninstall was confirmed at about 13:01 and the app is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: the AI Shopping Assistant, AI Product Questions, French or other languages, the quiz in the store preview, a recommendation result, integrations such as Klaviyo, any plan or paid feature and a data export. Clean up: the app was uninstalled after the test. In the theme the Brandye app embed was switched on and saved, and the Home page got an empty Apps section because the Quiz app block was not kept after a reload; this stays in the theme and was not changed further. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The first AI generation failed, the onboarding buttons reacted slowly, the quiz block showed empty in the theme preview and was not kept after a reload, and the plan page of Shopify said that no plans were available for the store.
